title: Fix lychee.toml: cache expects boolean not table
body:
The Check Links workflow failed with a TOML parse error because lychee v0.15.0 expects `cache` to be a boolean, not a table.

**Changed:**
```toml
# Before
[cache]
max_age = "0s"

# After  
cache = false
```

Error reference: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/21312192566/job/61350030087#step:3:1
